invalidation_closure.onInboxInvalidate / onInboxNew: inboxKeys.all(wsId) prefix reaches listInbox, listArchivedInboxPage (pages and lookup), getArchivedInboxFacets, listSnoozedInbox; excludes account unread summary.
invalidation_closure.onInboxIssueDeleted: local row prune + selection forgetRows; summary, pages, lookup, facets refresh
invalidation_closure.onInboxIssuesDeleted: empty ids no-op; cancel all lists; prune local rows and selection; summary/pages/lookup/facets; if interrupted, full workspace invalidation
invalidation_closure.refreshArchivedInboxMatches: pages/lookup/facets mark stale without refetch then cancel/invalidate each
invalidation_closure.patchInboxIssueProjection / patchInboxIs: local main/archive cache row projection; preserve stale mark with exact refetchType none; no immediate request
invalidation_closure.cancelInboxLists / isInboxListRequestInF: inspect fetch status and cancel; no new request

local_effects: Chat quick-actions pending/failure queryFns return null with enabled false; no transport.
Task message structuralSharing unions by seq; merge/union helpers and timeline-presence lookup are cache/local only.
Inbox placeholder/pagination/select/enabled callbacks transform data or gate standard query behavior.
Workspace rehydration registry invokes the store callback on queued workspace changes; cleanup registry stores reset callbacks which only set store slices.
Selection forgetRows removes held/left rows through Zustand only; no notification delivery API.

parent_review.conclusion: Parent closed remaining bounded edges: main.tsx:49 omits storage; CoreProvider defaults to defaultStorage and passes it to createChatStore. defaultStorage is localStorage. logger.ts complete body is timestamp formatting plus console methods. archivedInboxQuery uses local sorted strings, dimension lookup and local date helpers; groupInboxItemsByIssue/groupInboxRows/withCommentAnchor use arrays/maps and snooze/date ordering. All production map/patchArchivedInboxCache callbacks found in inbox mutations and ws-updaters are local find/map/projection transformations; mutation API dispatch is outside those patch callbacks. Existing listed invalidation/refetch union retained. Generic injected implementations beyond the active-web adapter remain an explicit interface contract, not an inferred request.

archivedInboxQuery, groupInboxItemsByIssue, isInboxItemSnoozed supporting implementations not semantically closed in this batch.
createLogger implementation not traced; logger methods are application callbacks, not proven transport-free here.
mapArchivedInboxCache and patchArchivedInboxCaches invoke caller-supplied patch(items): InboxItem[]; arbitrary caller behavior excluded, exact injection contract retained.
